user.title: Connect your Kiva account
user.description: Enter your Kiva API OAuth 1.0 credentials. You can create an app and obtain these at [kiva.org/build/docs]({docs_url}).

data_description.consumer_key: The App ID / Consumer Key from your Kiva developer app.
data_description.consumer_secret: The Consumer Secret from your Kiva developer app.
data_description.access_token: Your OAuth access token (obtained after authorizing the app).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Kiva — check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials — verify your Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, Access Token, and Access Token Secret.

abort.already_configured: This Kiva account is already configured.
